description: Office of the Public Service Commission - Minute of Sri Lanka Scientific Service 06 th Amendment
categorisation: This gazette notification amends the Minute of the Sri Lanka Scientific Service, specifically addressing recruitment procedures, educational qualifications, and examination details for public service positions. It is issued by the Public Service Commission and deals with public sector recruitment and service conditions, which falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8). The content does not involve government structure/personnel changes (Types 1-3) or fit any other specialized categories (4-7, 9).
